source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Απριλίου — «Δίκαιος Αχάζ»

attestations.note: The life page, https://www.saint.gr/159/saint.aspx, has its own «Ημερομηνία Εορτής» of 1 Απριλίου and «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή». Its whole notice is one sentence: «Ο Δίκαιος Αχάζ απεβίωσε ειρηνικά.» — the righteous Ahaz died peacefully. What identifies him is the second line of the distich the page prints over him, «Ἄχαζ Θεοῦ πέφυκεν ἑστὼς πλησίον, / Ἄχαζ, ὃς εἶπεν· οὐ Θεόν μου πειράσω» — Ahaz, who said, I will not tempt my God, which is Isaiah 7:12. There is no year, no place, no kin, no relic and no hymn, and no dates object could be written. The corpus keeps nobody of this name; the rows the name sweep proposed matched on the fold of a short name and none of them is a person of this name at all.
